verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents MFA for application users (appwrite-docs-4) and sign-in through 30+ OAuth social providers such as GitHub, Google and Apple (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-45, appwrite-docs-26). There is no evidence of enterprise SAML or generic OIDC SSO, and nothing showing a platform engineer can make MFA or SSO mandatory. missing for 10: SAML SSO support, generic/enterprise OIDC provider configuration, MFA enforcement policy (requiring rather than just offering MFA), SSO enforcement, independent corroboration.
